package cache

import (
 "context"
 "errors"
 "testing"
 "time"
 "github.com/alicebob/miniredis/v2"
)
func TestRedisAdapter(t *testing.T){
 server:=miniredis.RunT(t)
 t.Setenv("REDIS_URL","redis://"+server.Addr()+"/0")
 ctx:=context.Background()
 cache,err:=OpenRedis(ctx);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 defer cache.Close()
 if _,err:=cache.Get(ctx,"missing");!errors.Is(err,ErrMiss){t.Fatalf("expected cache miss, got %v",err)}
 if err:=cache.Set(ctx,"key",[]byte("payload"),time.Minute);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 value,err:=cache.Get(ctx,"key");if err!=nil || string(value)!="payload"{t.Fatal("value mismatch")}
 server.FastForward(2*time.Minute)
 if _,err:=cache.Get(ctx,"key");!errors.Is(err,ErrMiss){t.Fatal("TTL not applied")}
 if err:=cache.Set(ctx,"key",[]byte("payload"),0);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if err:=cache.Delete(ctx,"key");err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if _,err:=cache.Get(ctx,"key");!errors.Is(err,ErrMiss){t.Fatal("delete not applied")}
 if err:=cache.Set(ctx,"key",nil,-time.Second);err==nil{t.Fatal("negative TTL accepted")}
}
